name: Tatoeba API
summary: Community-built corpus of example sentences with translations in hundreds of languages, read-only and keyless.
description: The Tatoeba API searches sentences by text and language, returns a sentence with its translations and per-sentence license, and serves audio recordings. Stable endpoints sit under /v1, experimental ones under /unstable. It supersedes the old api_v0 search endpoint, which Tatoeba marks deprecated.

rate_limit.summary: Not documented in the spec or wiki page fetched.

license.name: Per sentence: mostly CC BY 2.0 FR, some CC0 (license field on each sentence)

agent_notes: Languages are ISO 639-3 (eng, deu, fra). sort is mandatory (for example relevance) or the call fails with 400. showtrans takes all, none or matching; combine matching with trans:lang to get translations in one language. Page with the cursor in paging.next (after=). Read each sentence's license and owner for attribution.
caveats: Without sort the API returns 400 'Required parameter sort missing'.
The old https://tatoeba.org/en/api_v0/search still answered 200 with a descriptive User-Agent (500 without one), but the wiki marks it deprecated.
Endpoints under /unstable may change; only /v1 is stable.

verification.notes: Exact example executed without a key.
